text:
elaine: quick dump on CAR-MEL11b bring-up. ran int8 and int6 q runs across 6k multi-turn samples (mix of chat + longform). results below.

ravi: nice. what's the unit-econ?

elaine: per 1k tokens: fp16 ~ $0.95, int8 ~ $0.26, int6 ~ $0.18 (back-of-envelope with our allocator). latencies p50/p95 (seq_len=512): fp16 120/240ms, int8 85/180ms, int6 70/165ms.

marta: quality numbers?

elaine: avg pairwise preference vs baseline (astra-13b-int8): fp16 +2.1% pref, int8 -0.8%, int6 -1.9%. longform summarization evals show int6 drops on factuality and coherence on >10 turns.

sam: so product tradeoffs. any regression flags?

elaine: for short-turn chat (<=3 turns, <=256 tokens) int6 is fine: latency gains >> quality drop. for long sessions (>8 turns) int8 preferred. suggest hybrid per-turn routing: prefix detection + KV cache reuse. see routing sketch below.

lia: can we present this to GTN as "economy-mode" for free-tier?

marta: yes but flag for occasional hallucination increase. suggest A/B with safety detector + human-in-loop for high-value flows.

elaine: routing sketch: 
```
routing:
  if turns <=3 and tokens_per_turn <=256 -> model: carmel-11b-int6
  elif turns <=8 -> carmel-11b-int8
  else -> carmel-11b-fp16 (or fallback 13b-int8)
```

ravi: perf caveat: int6 had slightly higher p95 memory spikes due to kernel fallback on seq>1024. need kernel fix.

elaine: opened issue #1389 for runtime kernel fallback. impact: occasional OOMs in canary. ops-bot: canary started on dedicated:carmel-canary1.

ops-bot: canary deploy 3091234578: succeeded (3/3 nodes), traffic 2%.

sam: recommendation for GTN: ship int6 as "latency-optimized" for chat + default to int8 for sessions, include cost savings estimates and fidelity caveats. liaison to PMs to draft copy.

lia: I'll draft product note. want numbers in table for one-pager.

elaine: attaching quick table below:
```
mode | latency p50 | p95 | 1k token cost | pref vs 13b-int8
fp16  | 120ms | 240ms | $0.95 | +2.1%
int8  | 85ms  | 180ms | $0.26 | -0.8%
int6  | 70ms  | 165ms | $0.18 | -1.9%
```

marta: tag GTN thread, include eval artifacts + sample failure cases.

sam: ok let's run a 7-day canary with 5% traffic ramp, add regression monitor comparing pairwise prefs daily. and automatic rollback trigger at >1.5% preference loss for core flows.

elaine: noted. i'll add rollout config to canary ticket.

ravi: thanks all. quick Q: any need for mixed-precision kernel? might help int6 hallucination.

elaine: good call — added to kernel issue.

lia: thanks team, I'll coordinate with GTN and copy legal for compliance doc.

ops-bot: canary metrics link: https://console.redwood/canaries/3091234578

marta: :thumbsup:
